name: unpaid-intern
description: Unpaid Intern: a free second brain for work. Turns your meeting transcripts, docs, tickets, and email into a morning briefing, meeting prep, status updates, and follow-ups with owners and dates, all in plain files you own. Guided setup, and it works with as much or as little as your company allows, from fully connected to chat only.

interface.shortDescription: A second brain for work, in plain files you own.
interface.longDescription: Hand it your meeting transcripts, docs, tickets, and email, and it hands back your morning briefing, prep for your next meeting, a status update ready to paste, and every follow-up with an owner and a date. It drafts; you decide what goes out.
defaultPrompt: Prep me for my next meeting
